ad_library.summary: Twilight Solar has run 2 active ads on Meta since 30 July 2026 - about 12 weeks - and they are two versions of one creative. Both send the click into a Facebook lead form, so none of the paid traffic ever reaches twilightsolar.com. Only ~2 results exist in the library, so this is a small advertiser: no spend or impression figures are published, and none are claimed here.

funnel.meaning: The click never reaches a page you own. Every lead is captured inside Facebook, so there is no pixel on your site, no retargeting pool, no landing page you can test, and no way to see what happens after the click.

findings: Two live ads (both started 30 July 2026, about 12 weeks) and every click goes into a Facebook lead form - the paid traffic never reaches twilightsolar.com. You own no pixel, no retargeting pool and no page you can A/B test.

The ad promises '280+ Happy Customers', but your own homepage counters read 128+ successful installations, 119+ satisfied customers and 12+ MW delivered. The ad is claiming more than double the number your site can prove.
Two versions of one creative and no second angle - no retargeting creative, no test structure, and no Telugu creative in a Telangana-first market.
The only contact email published on the site is a personal Gmail (Prabhakar.katkam@gmail.com), not a company-domain inbox - even though you own twilightsolar.com.

The site itself is solid: residential, commercial, industrial, EPC, O&M and consulting pages, subsidy and net-metering support messaging, and a clear 5-step process. That is good raw material that no paid traffic ever sees.
One caution for sizing this up: only ~2 ad results exist in the library, so treat this as a small advertiser, not a big spender.
next_steps: Point one ad at your own site
Send even one of the two live ads to an owned landing page instead of the Facebook form, so you can test, measure and retarget from it.
Make the ad claim match what the site proves (128+ / 119+ / 12+ MW), or update the site counters. A homeowner who clicks the ad and sees half the number loses trust before the first call.
Build a Hyderabad residential landing page

Your service pages already exist. Turn the Chengicherla/Hyderabad residential offer into one page: subsidy up to Rs. 78,000, net-metering support, free site evaluation, with the consultation form on it.
Run a Telugu and a Rs. 0-down/EMI version against the current creative. Two versions of the same ad cannot tell you which message works.
Publish info@twilightsolar.com (or similar) so paid enquiries do not depend on one person's personal inbox.

ads_audit.methodology: Control review follows the claude-ads Meta Ads audit catalog (github.com/vamsy16/claude-ads, ads/references/meta-audit.md). Each control is graded only where public evidence establishes it - Ad Library ad data and the lead's own landing page. Controls that require Ads Manager access (bidding, budgets, audiences, learning phase, EMQ, CAPI status) are marked unknown on purpose: they cannot be verified from outside the account and are never guessed.
